What we do

Two services that keep your property clean

Everything is set up under one agreement with your property — no individual sign-ups for residents, no extra workload for your leasing or maintenance staff.

Service 01 · Core Service

Valet Trash — Doorstep Pickup

Residents place bagged trash outside their front door on scheduled pickup nights. Our team collects it door by door and takes it to your on-site dumpster or compactor — so breezeways, halls, and parking lots stay clear.

  • Scheduled evening pickups across the whole community
  • Simple resident guidelines — tied bags, set out by the agreed time
  • Loose trash around doors and dumpster areas tidied as we go
  • A visible amenity residents actually use, every week
Service 02 · On Call

Bulk & Dump Removal

When big items pile up, we haul them off. One call clears out the furniture left at the dumpster, the unit a tenant left behind, or the mess after a busy move-out weekend.

  • Furniture, mattresses, and appliances removed
  • Move-out and eviction cleanouts
  • Dumpster & compactor area overflow and illegal-dumping cleanup
  • Available to contracted properties and as one-time jobs

Questions from managers

Before you call

Who signs the contract — residents or the property?+

The property. Hasan Trash Removal contracts directly with apartment owners and management companies, so one agreement covers the entire community. Residents don't sign up or pay us individually — they just set their bags out on pickup nights.

How is pricing figured?+

Pricing is quoted per property, based on the number of units, the layout of the community, and how many pickup nights per week you want. Call or send the quote form below and we'll put together a straightforward number for your property — no obligation.

What do residents have to do?+

Very little: bag and tie their household trash, set it outside their door by the agreed time on scheduled pickup nights, and bring any container back in by morning. We provide clear, simple guidelines you can share at rollout and move-in.

Can you handle furniture and bulk items too?+

Yes. Bulk and dump removal covers furniture, mattresses, appliances, move-out cleanouts, and dumpster-area overflow or illegal dumping. Contracted properties can add it as needed, and one-time jobs are available as well.

How fast can service start?+

Once the agreement is signed, we set a start date together and help you notify residents so the first pickup night runs smoothly. Call us and we'll map out a start timeline for your property.

Do you serve properties outside Indianapolis?+

Indianapolis is our service area right now. Nearby communities like Carmel, Fishers, Avon, and Greenwood are next on our expansion list — if you're there, get in touch and we'll flag your property for when routes open, and be upfront about timing.
